evidence: User-supplied build_worldmem_lookup_work_table.py output; raw CSV and aggregation code not independently audited here.
initial_history: User-confirmed protocol: 600 context frames precede the generated rollout; each generated frame adds one eligible memory for subsequent queries.
time_origin: Start of the 600 newly generated frames, excluding the initial context history.
aggregation: Reported arithmetic means over 150 consecutive generated-frame queries per window; eligible count at generated index k is 600 + k, for k=0..599.
fov_work_proxy: User reports 10,000 spatial samples per query. Candidate count times 10,000 is a logical candidate-point workload proxy, not latency or FLOPs; it excludes other operations and eight greedy selection passes. Not included in the unified count table.
